ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Cuts on Minnesota Residents
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of impending Medicaid cuts on Minnesota residents, particularly vulnerable populations.
questions: How many residents will be affected?
What are the potential health consequences?
ideas.insight: Understanding the impact of Medicaid cuts on Minnesota residents can shed light on the consequences of healthcare policy changes.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of 'Phantom Billing' Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the 'phantom billing' fraud scheme targeting Medicare recipients and Minnesota taxpayers.
ideas.insight: Exposing the extent of 'phantom billing' fraud can lead to significant recoveries and help prevent future abuse.
